catalogue_diagnosis: The generic database candidate matcher compares a physical database key slot. Catalogue Control paths deliberately map to no database slot, so it rejected both valid named-delete calls despite exact Creation, operation, principal, revisions and nonce. The correction binds the full Creation, control identity, current HTTP principal, daemon and original forward/invoke/backend/product-response ordering; generic database matching is unchanged.

accepted_counterexample.name: query-not-forwarded-during-held-resume
accepted_counterexample.cause: A forwarded query timestamp was moved after fault_forward_resumed but before s3_forward_started. The old guard only compared S3 forwarding, so it accepted a call not forwarded while the hold was still in effect.
accepted_counterexample.correction: Both same-actor queued query and second resume must have HTTP forward_finished strictly before fault_release_requested. Keep all original runner actions, input counts, timeouts and target guard names.

independent_raw_index.semantics: Immutable original event membership/order/identity and duplicates are retained. Index only selects event kind; every guard still executes. Mutable counterexample ledgers remain ordinary lists.
